**Tier 2.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: `activity`, `catalog`, `commerce`, `identity`, `messaging`, `plugins`, `settings`, `vintedReviews`, `vouchers`.

Currently imports: `catalog`, `plugins`.

Feature map entry: `seo` in [tuucho/docs/features.json](../../../../../docs/features.json). Run `npm run feature -- seo` for its full span.

## Routes

- `GET /admin/seo`
- `POST /admin/seo/redirects`
- `DELETE /admin/seo/redirects/:id`
- `GET /sitemap.xml`
- `GET /storefront/robots.txt`

## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

Kernel owns SEO primitives for kernel-created things: product and kernel-page
canonicals (catalog still composes document meta / JSON-LD), sitemap and shop
robots assembly, `seo_redirects` storage, Settings → SEO, public
`GET /sitemap.xml` and `GET /storefront/robots.txt`. API-origin `/robots.txt`
stays `crawlerPolicy` and must never be shop robots.

Public indexing is on only when `APP_TARGET=prod`. `dev` and `preprod` emit
`noindex, nofollow`, shop robots `Disallow: /`, and do not publish
`/sitemap.xml`. NODE_ENV must not flip this.

Plugins extend through `seo.sitemap.entries`, `seo.robots.rules`,
`seo.redirects.rules`, `seo.meta`, and `seo.jsonld.graph`. Stored redirects
apply only while `tuucho-seo-redirects` is effectively on. Extra sitemap URLs
and robots rules appear only while their contributing plugins are loaded.

<!-- invariants:end -->
